textbookBox.concept: Work is done when a force moves an object in the direction of the force: W = F x s. The SI unit is the joule.

beats.en: Work is done when a force moves an object in the direction of the force: W = F x s. The SI unit is the joule.
beats.speakEn: Work is done when a force moves an object in the direction of the force: W  equals  F x s. The SI unit is the joule.

beats.en: The work-energy theorem says the net work done on an object equals the change in its kinetic energy.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 9 science · Work, Energy, and Simple Machines · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Energy is the capacity to do work. It exists in forms such as kinetic, potential, heat, light, sound, electrical and chemical energy.

beats.en: Energy is the capacity to do work. It exists in forms such as kinetic, potential, heat, light, sound, electrical and chemical energy.
beats.speakEn: Energy is the capacity to do work. It exists in forms such as kinetic, potential, heat, light, sound, electrical and chemical energy.

beats.en: Kinetic energy is 1/2 m v^2 and gravitational potential energy is m g h. Their sum is the mechanical energy.
beats.speakEn: Kinetic energy is 1/2 metres v^2 and gravitational potential energy is m g h. Their sum is the mechanical energy.
